title: Grateful Dead Live at University Hall, University Of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby-B in) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged.
source: Source: FOB Beyers M88's > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XLIIS-90 (1st Set, He's Gone, and JBGoode) and TDK MA-90 (2nd Set). Concert recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!

ai_review.summary: An excellent audience recording with crisp stereo imaging captures a high‑energy 1982 show packed with rare gems like High Time, Aiko and a monster Supplication.
ai_review.review: The Beyer mic capture delivers an unusually clear and well‑balanced sound for an audience tape—ride cymbals stay open, the stereo image is spot‑on and there are no phase problems. Musically the concert is solid from start to finish, featuring tight first‑set work, rare post‑drum placements of High Time and Aiko, and a standout 13‑minute Supplication that lifts the energy to a high level.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers are enthusiastic (4–5 stars), note superb show performance and excellent recording quality, with consistent praise for rare songs and sound clarity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Beyer microphone provides a clean, wide‑stereo field; ride cymbals are not squashed, no phase issues, and the FOH PA mix is well balanced, making this arguably the best audience tape of the show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A tight, confident first set flows into a second set that features seamless transitions (notably China>Rider) and rare song placements; the pacing stays engaging throughout with a climactic Supplication.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for singing from his instrument, delivering sweet effortless licks and strong vocal performances.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted hitting great notes and adding high points especially on Deal and throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Described as dialed‑in with an organic tone, providing solid rhythm guitar and vocals.
